mentions.name: Teletest
mentions.description: This company lets Canadians order bloodwork and lab testing online, bringing the easy lab-testing experience available in the USA to Canada and improving the overall patient healthcare experience in Canada.
mentions.problem: Ordering bloodwork and lab testing in Canada is not easy, and the patient healthcare experience in Canada needs improvement.
mentions.audience: Canadian patients seeking easier access to bloodwork and lab testing.
mentions.source_excerpt:
One thing I liked about the USA was how easy it was to order bloodwork/lab testing. My original idea was to bring that experience to Canada, but since starting I've found other ways to improve the patient healthcare experience in Canada too.

My company is https://teletest.ca
mentions.author: theatraine
